title: AnswerKeyRow
description: One row of an evaluation-only answer key: the ground truth of one case, keyed by case_id. Written by bench (RCAEval labels), lab (VeylLab orchestrator) and core.synth; read only by bench and lab, never by engines.

case_id.description: Opaque case id, as in case_manifest.case_id. RCAEval normal windows have no row of their own: bench identifies them by case_id plus bench_result.variant.

dataset.description: Dataset id, as in case_manifest.dataset (e.g. synth, re2-ob, veyllab-ob).

system.description: Benchmark system of the case, as in case_manifest.system.

is_no_fault.description: True for a no-fault case (synth-05, VeylLab F14 controls).

root_service.description: Root-cause service in normalised form; null for no-fault cases.

root_component.description: Root-cause component (container, pod or datastore) when the dataset labels one; null otherwise.

fault_class.description: Fault class of the root, mapped to the closed fault_class vocabulary.

fault_label.description: The dataset's own fault label before mapping (e.g. the fault part of an RCAEval folder name such as cpu or f3); free string.

indicator.description: Root indicator in Causatrix's indicator vocabulary, for fine-grained (service, indicator) scoring.

mode.description: Fault mode of the root (e.g. code for RCAEval RE3, change for a change-induced regression).

t_inject_ns.description: Injection start, int64 ns since the Unix epoch (UTC); null for no-fault cases.

t_end_ns.description: Injection end, int64 ns since the Unix epoch (UTC); null when unknown or for no-fault cases.

injection_json.description: Canonical JSON object {fault_id, tool, tool_version, params, severity, seed}: the injector and every parameter used; null when the dataset does not publish them (RCAEval).

fault_id.description: Fault catalog id (e.g. F01..F16 in the VeylLab catalog).

params.description: Injector parameters as a free map (e.g. delay_ms, loss_pct, workers).

severity.description: Severity level of the injection (e.g. L1, L2); value type not fixed in v0.1.

seed.description: Seed of the injector or plan; value type not fixed in v0.1.

extra_roots_json.description: Canonical JSON describing the additional roots of a multi-fault case (VeylLab F15); shape not fixed in v0.1; null for single-root cases.

decoy_changes_json.description: Canonical JSON array [{t_ns, entity, kind, is_true}] of the change events planted around the injection (RCAEval-C overlays, VeylLab and synth decoys); is_true marks the true change on the root. Null when the case has no planted changes.

t_ns.description: Change time, int64 ns since the Unix epoch (UTC), as in telemetry.events.t_ns.

entity.description: Changed service or component, as in telemetry.events.entity.

is_true.description: True for the true change on the root, false for a decoy.

validated.description: Lab cases: true if the 05 §8.2 validation rule passed (user-facing latency or error rate actually moved); null outside the lab.

sli_impact_json.description: Lab cases: canonical JSON of the measured entry-service SLI change; shape not fixed in v0.1; null outside the lab.
